sources.quote: 4.2 A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that
Correct, the audit qualifies the company. Part approvals stay as they are.

findings.why: The ASL covers HS-410 for PLT-BEI and CUST-AUR (SUP-G, SUP-E), but has no entry for Meccanica Chisone. The re-audit on 2026-11-06 restored company standing only and gives no part approval.

sources.quote: 7.1 The supplier shall obtain written approval from Aurelia (PPAP resubmission) before shipping parts
7.2 Aurelia shall be notified of every planned change at least 90 days before implementation.

findings.why: HS-410 belongs to PRG-X, an Aurelia program. Revision 4 of the Aurelia manual is in force and replaces revision 3. It requires written approval (PPAP) for a change of source and 90 days' notice. Approval is per part and site. No existing approval or deviation covers this change.

The drawing requires Steel DC04. Chisone is qualified only for aluminium (MAT-6061-T6, MAT-6082-T5). Its commodity is aluminium extrusions and blanks, and it has no capability record for DC04 steel stamping.

sources.quote: 4.4 A change of source requires a material certificate (EN 10204 type 3.1) from the new supplier for

findings.why: There is no 3.1 certificate for SUP-C and MAT-DC04. The only SUP-C certificates are for aluminium. The supplier quality engineer (PER-GALLO) must follow up.
